title: Gelyn configuration
description: Settings gelyn reads from gelyn.json in the working directory, or from the file given to --config.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema, so that editors offer completion and validation.

Language.description: The language of the generated pages, written to the lang attribute of every document as a BCP 47 tag.

Author.description: The name written to the author meta tag, or null to leave the tag out of every document.

Description.description: The description written to the description meta tag by any page whose front matter declares none, or null to leave the tag out of such pages.

BaseUrl.description: The absolute http or https URL the finished site is served from, such as https://example.com/blog, or null when no absolute URL is known. Its path prefixes every link, and is empty for null and for the root of a domain. Its origin gives each page a canonical URL.

EnableFeed.description: Indicates whether the build writes a syndication feed of the pages whose front matter declares enableFeed. Every entry carries an absolute URL, so the feed requires BaseUrl and is not written while it is null.

EnableSitemap.description: Indicates whether the build writes a sitemap of the pages it publishes. Every location in it is an absolute URL, so the sitemap requires BaseUrl and is not written while it is null.

FooterLinks.description: The links listed in the footer of every page, in the order declared here. The feed and the sitemap follow them whenever the build publishes those documents.

Label.description: The text the link reads as.

Url.description: The absolute http or https URL the link addresses.

Theme.description: The name of the bundled theme every page is styled with, or null to apply none. Its stylesheet and script are written to the root of the output directory, and every page links them ahead of the site's own.

KaTeXVersion.description: The version of KaTeX that a page whose front matter sets enableMathRendering requests from jsDelivr, such as 0.19.0.

MermaidVersion.description: The version of Mermaid that a page whose front matter sets enableDiagramRendering requests from jsDelivr, such as 12.1.0.

ShikiVersion.description: The version of Shiki that a page whose front matter sets enableSyntaxHighlighting requests from jsDelivr, such as 4.6.0.

Giscus.description: The giscus backend a page declaring enableComments renders a comment thread from, or null to render none, whatever a page declares. Each thread is a GitHub discussion in the repository Repo names.

RepoId.description: The repository id the giscus configuration page shows.

Category.description: The discussion category giscus creates threads in.

CategoryId.description: The category id the giscus configuration page shows.

ContentDirectory.description: The directory the site is built from, holding the Markdown sources and anything published beside them. Relative values are resolved against the content root, which is the working directory unless DOTNET_CONTENTROOT points elsewhere.

OutputDirectory.description: The directory the generated site is written to. Relative values are resolved against the content root, as for ContentDirectory. Each build overwrites the files it publishes there and deletes the ones no source accounts for.

ExcludePatterns.description: Patterns naming the entries the build leaves out, matched case insensitively against the name of each file and directory, never against its path, with * and ? as the only wildcards. A directory that matches is not descended into.

Port.description: The loopback port gelyn serve listens on, read once when the server starts.
